description: This file defines a set of functions in CMake scripting language to handle JSON data structures, including building and parsing JSON objects, arrays, and literals. It provides callbacks for constructing JSON and likely serves as a utility module for JSON serialization/deserialization within CMake projects.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Main function for handling JSON data structures, setting up callbacks, and initiating JSON parsing or building operations.

methods.name: json_obj_begin
methods.description: Callback to append the beginning of a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_end
methods.description: Callback to append the end of a JSON object.

methods.name: json_array_begin
methods.description: Callback to append the beginning of a JSON array.

methods.name: json_array_end
methods.description: Callback to append the end of a JSON array.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin
methods.description: Callback to handle the beginning of a key-value pair in a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end
methods.description: Callback to handle the end of a key-value pair in a JSON object, adding comma if needed.

methods.name: json_array_element_end
methods.description: Callback to handle the end of an element in a JSON array, adding comma if needed.

methods.name: json_literal
methods.description: Handles JSON literal values such as null, boolean, numbers, and strings.
